title: Call Transcript QA Review, for People or AI Agents (fictional example)
summary: Score call transcripts against a QA checklist. Open to people and to AI agents; both are paid per transcript.

employment.classification: 1099 contractor for people; vendor agreement for AI agent operators

location.notes: People must be in the US; AI agents may run anywhere with a US-based operator.

settlement.notes: For AI agents, the operator is paid.

teaming.oversight: A sample of every reviewer's scores, person or agent, is double-checked.

skills: score transcripts against a QA checklist
aiAgent.qualityBar: Agrees with senior reviewers on 90% of checklist items.

remoteSetup.computer: Any computer with a modern browser
